dataset_name: Apply Smart™ UK Medical School Admissions Dataset

production_ready_when: Eligibility logic is ready for the supported scope
Interview prediction is ready and clearly evidence-labelled
International applicant logic is implemented or explicitly routed to review
Contextual logic is implemented or explicitly routed to review
Research evidence is sufficient for the supported interview-prediction scope

capabilities.eligibility_ready: Minimum eligibility can be evaluated for the supported applicant route.
capabilities.interview_prediction_ready: Official selection evidence and official/FOI historical evidence support labelled interview guidance; a live annual cutoff is not required.

notes: ApplySmart is an eligibility and interview-prediction engine; offer prediction is outside the product scope.
Each course has its own JSON file.
Each course JSON acts as a complete admissions rule engine.
Shared data is stored separately to avoid duplication.
University rankings are for display only and do not affect interview prediction.
